preconditions.description: The number of teams n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of wins per team k must be between 1 and 1000.
The total number of wins must not exceed the maximum possible number of matches.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if n * k > (n * (n - 1)) // 2 else True
postconditions.description: If the total number of wins exceeds the maximum possible matches, output -1.
The number of matches output must equal the total number of wins.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in matches)
postconditions.description: Each match must involve distinct teams within the valid range.
